description: This file contains a Java class implementation for managing static content cache in the SalesManager application. It extends a base CacheManager class and follows the singleton pattern to provide a single cache manager instance. The class is responsible for handling cache related to static content types such as CSS, JS, and digital data.

classes.name: StaticContentCacheManagerImpl
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for caching static content data such as CSS, JS, and digital data using Infinispan cache.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of StaticContentCacheManagerImpl.
